title: 2027 SeaWorld Concert Series
summary: SeaWorld Brings LIVE MUSIC to 2027 with EXPANDED AND ELEVATED CONCERT SERIES FEATURING MORE THAN 50 SHOWS
body_markdown:
ORLANDO, Fla., SAN DIEGO, SAN ANTONIO (Nov. 19, 2026) – SeaWorld is ready to groove in 2027 with an expanded and elevated, coast-to-coast live music concert series featuring more than 50 live shows, unveiled today across its parks in Orlando, San Diego and San Antonio. An added value for guests, the full-length concerts of 60+ minutes feature more headlining acts, all included with park admission. For fans who want to catch every show, an Annual Pass is the best option, opening the door to the full 2027 lineup.


Florida’s own Flo Rida will kick off SeaWorld Orlando’s popular Seven Seas Food Festival concert series on January 30, 2027, featuring 29 concerts with live performances most Saturdays and Sundays through May 16, 2027. SeaWorld San Diego offers 16 concerts starting on March 20 through the end of August and SeaWorld San Antonio features seven spring concerts from April through May. The 2027 series blends a range of genres, nostalgia-driven favorites and contemporary performers, offering guests multiple opportunities to enjoy full-length live concerts.


The national lineup includes acts such as Flo Rida, Lee Brice, Taking Back Sunday, Nicky Jam, Soulja Boy, K-pop group EVERGLOW, Lil Jon, Justin Moore, JoJo Siwa, Skillet, Luísa Sonza, Sugar Ray, Elvis Crespo, CeeLo Green, E-40 and Rick Ross.


With concerts included in park admission and available across multiple events and weekends, an Annual Pass offers guests the most flexible way to access the full 2027 concert lineup from the start of the season. With the biggest sale of the year happening now for Black Friday, guests can take advantage of savings up to 65% on Annual Passes.


Guests wanting to get a front row seat for a maximum concert experience can purchase reserved access.


Guests can expect:


- Full-length live concerts, 60+ minutes, included with all forms of park admission
- A full-day park experience that pairs food festivals, attractions, and animal encounters with evening live music performances
- The flexibility to attend multiple concerts throughout the season with an Annual Pass
- Limited-time ticket and Pass offers available by location
- Option to upgrade concert experience with reserved access


“We’re very excited about our concert series for 2027,” said Marc Swanson, CEO of United Parks & Resorts. “We’ve booked headline-worthy performers across a broad mix of genres, appealing to a wide variety of music lovers. It’s a thrilling addition to a SeaWorld day, and it really showcases the fun and outstanding value these parks offer.”


### SeaWorld Orlando


This year’s Seven Seas Food Festival takes guests on a musical and culinary journey around the world, drawing inspiration from the sounds and flavors of different destinations. At Bayside Stadium, the festival will feature 29 full-length concerts on select dates from late January through mid-May.


Program highlights include:


- A broad mix of country, pop, classic rock, alternative rock, hard rock, Latin, hip-hop, R&B, rap, reggae, K-pop, and Electronic/EDM.
- Featured performers such as Flo Rida, Lee Brice, Taking Back Sunday, Nicky Jam, JoJo Siwa, Blue Oyster Cult, Skillet, Shaggy, K-pop group EVERGLOW, Lil Jon, Justin Moore, Soulja Boy, Scotty McCreery and Luísa Sonza.
- Weekend concerts staged at Bayside Stadium throughout the spring season.


### SeaWorld San Diego


SeaWorld San Diego’s live music series delivers 16 live concerts, running from spring through late summer across two signature seasonal events.


Program highlights include:


- Concerts performed at the Bayside Amphitheater along Mission Bay.
- Performances integrated into the Seven Seas Food Festival and Summer Concert Series.
- A genre-spanning lineup featuring hip-hop, R&B, rap, pop, and rock, with throwback favorites alongside contemporary artists, including Rick Ross, E-40, CeeLo Green, Lil Jon, Soulja Boy, Ying Yang Twins, Taking Back Sunday, and Juvenile.


### SeaWorld San Antonio


SeaWorld San Antonio includes seven live full-length concerts as part of its Seven Seas Food Festival in 2027, adding select concerts to the spring season.


Program highlights include:


- Performance dates from mid-April through late May.
- A mix of rock, hip-hop, pop, Latin, Christian, and throwback music.
- Acts include Sugar Ray, Elvis Crespo, Skillet, JoJo Siwa, Soulja Boy, Puddle of Mudd, Alien Ant Farm, and Pop 2000 featuring Chris Kirkpatrick of *NSYNC, O-Town, Ryan Cabrera, and LFO.


### Guest Access and Annual Pass Value


SeaWorld’s 2027 concert series is included with regular park admission, giving guests added value during their visit. Annual Pass Members can enjoy season-long access to multiple concerts across parks and events, along with the flexibility to attend performances throughout the spring and summer.


For a limited time, guests can take advantage of the Black Friday Sale, the biggest of the year, with savings up to 65% off Annual Passes, the best way to enjoy as many concerts as guests would like.


Park-specific concert schedules, ticket options, and Annual Pass details are available at[SeaWorld Orlando](https://seaworld.com/orlando) ,[SeaWorld San Diego](https://seaworld.com/san-diego/) and[SeaWorld San Antonio](https://seaworld.com/san-antonio) .


### About SeaWorld


SeaWorld is a leading marine life theme park and accredited zoo and aquarium that provides experiences that matter while educating and inspiring guests of all ages to care about marine life. Welcoming millions of guests every year, the parks offer fun and enriching experiences ranging from up-close animal encounters and year-round educational programs to award-winning marine-life-themed rides, special events, and live entertainment. For more than 60 years, SeaWorld has advanced marine conservation through science, education, and exceptional animal care. SeaWorld is one of the largest marine animal rescue organizations in the world, having helped more than 43,000 animals to date. SeaWorld parks are in Orlando, San Antonio, San Diego, and Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates (UAE). SeaWorld is part of the United Parks & Resorts Inc. (NYSE: PRKS) portfolio of theme park brands. For more information, visit[SeaWorld.com](https://seaworld.com/) .
